description: Progress earned after a failed read of the saved player is merged into the real player once storage reads again. `storage.failReads` makes the first N reads of the player throw. The session player starts empty, so this device's counters are added, not joined by max.

cases.name: a retry that reads the saved player merges the session into it and saves
cases.note: Progress made after the failed read is added to the saved player. This device's counters add, other devices stay, best is the larger, unknown fields stay, the name stays. The event reports the merged total. The reload proves it was saved.

cases.name: a retry that fails again saves nothing and keeps the session
the retry waits for the interval, 30 seconds by default
cases.note: The failed read at init counts as the last read. 29 seconds later no retry happens, at 30 seconds one does. The reload proves it was saved.

cases.name: merged achievements keep the earliest unlock, seen from either side, and count their reward once
cases.note: The session unlocks a1 again and a2 for the first time. a1 keeps the saved unlockedAt and reward, seen is true, and its reward is not added a second time. The reload proves it was saved.

cases.name: the streak continues from the saved last play date
cases.note: The saved days are 5 and 6 August. Today's visit adds one day. The reload proves it was saved.

cases.name: a saved play day today is not counted twice
cases.note: The saved days already include today, so the visit adds nothing. The reload proves it was saved.

cases.name: a gap in the saved days starts a new streak and keeps the longest
cases.note: The saved last day is a week ago. The current streak is 1, the stored longest of 5 stays. The reload proves it was saved.

cases.name: a saved device that is not this one keeps its numbers
an own backup imported while blocked is not counted twice
cases.note: The import joins this device's counters by max into the session, but they are not progress made here. The retry takes the larger of saved and imported, then adds only what the session earned on top. Without that, this device's 100 XP and 2 games would count twice.

cases.name: an own backup ahead of the saved player is kept, and the session adds on top
cases.note: Saved holds 100 for this device, the import holds 150. The retry keeps 150 and adds the session's own gain of 1.

cases.name: the event and the return of the recovering addXP report the merged player
cases.note: Saved holds 5000 XP at level 10. The session earned 5. xp_gained carries the merged total and level. The player was already level 10, so leveledUp is false and level_up does not fire.

cases.name: a recovering addXP that crosses a level on the merged total fires level_up from the saved level
cases.note: Saved holds 95 XP at level 1. The session earned 10. The merged total is 105, which crosses level 2, so leveledUp is true and level_up goes from 1 to 2.

cases.name: a failed re-init after a good one does not count the loaded player as progress
cases.note: The first init read this device's 100 XP and 2 games from storage and addXP(10) saved. The re-init cannot read, then storage heals. The recovery adds only the 1 XP earned since, not the loaded player again.

cases.name: an empty import and an import of another device while the device id is unknown still recover
cases.note: The device id cannot be read at init, so the session has a temporary one. The retry finds the stored id and moves the session under it. An import that carries nothing of that id does not block it.

cases.name: an import of the stored device id while the id is unknown keeps saves blocked
cases.note: The import carries entries under the id that the retry finds, and they cannot be told from progress made here. The retry fails closed: nothing is saved and no event fires. init() or reset() ends it, and the session is lost.

cases.name: importing the session's own export while blocked does not count it twice
cases.note: The export holds the 50 XP earned this session. Importing it again adds nothing, so the recovery stores 100 + 50 + 1.

cases.name: importing an export taken after a backup import and a gain does not count either twice
cases.note: A backup of 100 is imported, 10 XP is earned, and the export (110) is imported back. The recovery stores 100 + 10 + 1.

cases.name: a stored id found at the retry stays blocked when the session already holds its entries
cases.note: The player reads at init but the device id does not, and the device id cannot be saved, so the session uses a temp id while its player already holds the real id's 100 XP. A failed re-init and 5 XP follow. The retry finds the real id. Moving the session under it would count the 100 twice (200), so the retry fails closed: nothing is saved, no event, and the stored 100 stays.
